__NOTOC__ {{Recipe summary | Category = Recipes for dessert | Difficulty = 3 }} {{recipe}} '''Arisa pitha''' is a sweet filled [[Cookbook:Pancake|pancake]] from Odisha, India. It is made using sugar and a sweet pitha. A thick jantani (semi-solid mixture) of rice flour and sugar or jaggery is made into small semi-flat round shapes and fried in ghee or oil until golden brown. The crispy outer layer surrounds the soft insides. == Ingredients == === Dough === *2 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]] (8.5 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]) water *0.5 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] [[Cookbook:Jaggery|jaggery]] or raw [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] *½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] *1 tsp powdered [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] *1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Ghee|ghee]] *1 kg [[Cookbook:Rice Flour|rice flour]] === Filling === * Ghee * Shredded fresh [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]] flesh * Sugar === Additional ingredients === * 200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]] or ghee * [[Cookbook:Sesame Seed|Sesame seeds]] == Procedure == # '''Dough:''' [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] water in a wide-mouth pan. Stir in sugar, salt, cinnamon, and ghee. Slowly and continuously stir in the rice flour. Cover the pan, and cook over low heat until the water is absorbed. The dough should be the consistency of chapati dough. Let cool. # '''Filling:''' Melt the ghee in a pan over medium heat. Add coconut and sugar. Cook, stirring, until the coconut turns golden brown. # '''Assembly:''' Knead the cooled rice mixture to make a smooth dough. Make small balls of dough, roll them, and stuff with the fried coconut mixture and sesame seeds. # Deep fry the filled pastries in the oil or ghee until golden brown all over.[http://www.orissadiary.com/orissa_cusine/Arisa%20Pitha.htm Arisa Pitha]
[http://recipe.fullorissa.com/GoodCooking.aspx?categ=Courses&kind=Pitha&recpId=4 Arisa Pitha]
